scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n SITE,API,AEO -c green,blue,magenta "npm run dev:site" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:aeo"
scripts.build:dashboard: npm run verify:workspaces && npm run build -w apps/aeo-web
scripts.build:marketing: npm run verify:workspaces && npm run build -w apps/aeo-marketing
scripts.verify:workspaces: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const cp=require('node:child_process');const pkgPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'package.json');if(!fs.existsSync(pkgPath)){console.error('[verify:workspaces] Missing package.json in current directory. Vercel is likely building the wrong root directory/repository.');process.exit(1);}let pkg;try{pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgPath,'utf8'));}catch(error){console.error('[verify:workspaces] Cannot parse package.json:',error instanceof Error?error.message:String(error));process.exit(1);}const workspaces=Array.isArray(pkg.workspaces)?pkg.workspaces:Array.isArray(pkg.workspaces?.packages)?pkg.workspaces.packages:[];if(!workspaces.includes('apps/*')){console.error('[verify:workspaces] package.json workspaces must include apps/* at repo root.');process.exit(1);}let source='npm -s workspaces list';let names=[];try{const output=cp.execSync('npm -s workspaces list',{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']});names=output.split(/\r?\n/).map((line)=>line.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((line)=>line.split(/\s+/)[0]);}catch{source='npm -s ls --workspaces --json';try{const output=cp.execSync('npm -s ls --workspaces --json',{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']});const parsed=JSON.parse(output);names=Object.keys(parsed.dependencies||{});}catch(error){console.error('[verify:workspaces] Unable to list npm workspaces. Check Vercel repository + Root Directory settings.');if(error&&typeof error==='object'&&'stderr' in error&&error.stderr){console.error(String(error.stderr).trim());}process.exit(1);}}const required=['@raimond/aeo-web','@raimond/aeo-marketing'];const missing=required.filter((name)=>!names.includes(name));if(missing.length){console.error('[verify:workspaces] Missing required workspaces: '+missing.join(', '));console.error('[verify:workspaces] Vercel is likely building the wrong repo/root directory.');console.error('[verify:workspaces] Workspace listing source: '+source);console.error('[verify:workspaces] Found: '+(names.length?names.join(', '):'(none)'));process.exit(1);}console.log('[verify:workspaces] OK ('+source+')');console.log('[verify:workspaces] Found: '+names.join(', '));"
